resenas.texto: This was my first experience getting my eyelashes done and Sun killed it! She was so kind and very skilled every step of the way. I am so happy with how my eyelashes and eyebrows turned out!

Sun did an unbelievable job with my lash lift & tint! I did not know my natural lashes could look like this! I wish I had this done my whole life. The experience was comfortable and professional. She walked me thru all the steps and really made me walk out feeling GORGEOUS.

My dearest friend has seen Sun for years and highly recommended her. Sun was amazing from the moment we met: welcoming, warm, gentle, curious to understand my routine and expectations, informative about procedures and related maintenance, answered all my questions, and made recommendations to help me decide what to try.
